ledger_scope: Flagged material claims and ambiguities, after reading all six held-out summary/synthesis outputs against the supplied sources. Supported content is described through coverage and review notes; this is not an exhaustive standardized atomic-claim denominator.
supported_content_review: The major Hunnic sequence, Valens conditions/bribery, Ad Salices extraction result, social reforms, literary emperors/books and late imperial events are supported apart from identified flags. H3 preserves the hypothetical rescue qualification rather than inventing a successful recapture. H4 keeps source/OCR Manuel and John numbering. Source author judgments are mostly attributed; untagged adjectives remain separate from invented events.
citation_review: H4-Q4 wrongly cites 364 instead of 365. Summary admission conditions are on 63, not 62; Manuel’s succession is on 359, not 360; Suleiman gains span 360–362; vassalage is on 365, not 363; exhaustion/poverty are on 366, not 365. These locator errors largely recur in merged output. Full control uses recoverable parenthesized physical-page citations, so zero literal PDF markers does not mean no citations.
synthesis_review: Merged output copies almost all parent wording, removing only the initial author notes that from H1; six clear parent error families propagate. That removed attribution is an additional format/attribution flag. The full-source control repeats the food-direction error independently, and introduces three other clear families. It allocates three paragraphs to H1 and one to H2, omitting H3/H4. No output cap explains these omissions.
annotation_limits: Qualification loss, event contradiction, citation drift, attribution and ambiguous language are distinct. Flag counts are not independent false-fact totals or comparable precision percentages.
